heading_en: Deemed Calculation of Credit Risk-Weighted Assets for Ultimate Designated Parent Companies Adopting the Internal Ratings-Based Approach
summary_ja: 保有エクスポージャーの信用リスク・アセットの額を直接算出できない場合に、裏付けとなる資産等の情報に応じて、みなし計算（ルックスルー等）により算出する方法を定める。
summary_en: Where credit risk-weighted assets of a held exposure cannot be calculated directly, prescribes the deemed (look-through) calculation, with fallbacks depending on the availability and verification of information on the underlying assets, up to a 1,250% risk weight.

sections_en.第三節 第五款: Deemed Calculation of Credit Risk-Weighted Assets

paragraphs: Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach is unable to directly calculate the amount of credit risk-weighted assets of a held exposure, it shall calculate the amount of credit risk-weighted assets of that held exposure as provided in this Article.

Where the information on the exposures of the underlying assets, etc. of a held exposure satisfies all of the following requirements, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall use, as the amount of credit risk-weighted assets of that held exposure, the amount obtained by multiplying the amount of the exposure by the ratio obtained by dividing the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets of the underlying assets, etc. by the amount of total assets of the entity that actually holds those underlying assets, etc.: (i) The information is obtained sufficiently and frequently by that Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach; (ii) The information is verified by an independent third party.

In the case referred to in the preceding paragraph, when an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach calculates the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets of the underlying assets, etc. of a held exposure, Article 128 applies mutatis mutandis, deeming that Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach to be the person directly holding those underlying assets, etc. In this case, the phrase "the sum of the amounts listed" in that Article shall be deemed to be replaced with "the sum of the amounts listed (excluding the amount listed in item (iv))"; the phrase "including the amount of credit risk-weighted assets" in item (i) of that Article shall be deemed to be replaced with "including the amount of credit risk-weighted assets, and, for derivative transactions whose counterparty is a person other than those listed in the items of Article 248-2, paragraph (2), the amount of credit risk-weighted assets calculated by taking, as the EAD of the derivative transaction, the amount obtained by multiplying by 1.5 the EAD calculated pursuant to Article 134, paragraph (7) or Article 142, paragraph (5)"; and the phrase "is deemed to be replaced" in item (ii) of that Article shall be deemed to be replaced with ", and the phrase 'credit equivalent amount' in item (i) of the same Article is deemed to be replaced with 'credit equivalent amount (where those derivative transactions include a derivative transaction whose counterparty is a person other than those listed in the items of Article 248-2, paragraph (2), the credit equivalent amount of off-balance sheet transactions, the amount obtained by multiplying by 1.5 the credit equivalent amount of that derivative transaction, the credit equivalent amount of derivative transactions other than that derivative transaction, and the credit equivalent amount of long settlement period transactions)', is deemed to be replaced".

In calculating, pursuant to the preceding paragraph, the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets of the underlying assets, etc. of a held exposure, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall calculate the amount of credit risk-weighted assets of securitization exposures included in the underlying assets, etc. of that held exposure by the external ratings-based method prescribed in Division 3 of Subsection 2 of Section 2 of the following Chapter.

Where, in the case of paragraph (2), an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach, having attempted to calculate the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets of the underlying assets, etc. of a held exposure, is unable to satisfy only the requirement listed in item (i) of that paragraph, and the information on the exposures of those underlying assets, etc. is obtained sufficiently and frequently by a third party, it may calculate that total amount by applying the risk weights determined by that third party to those exposures.

Where the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets of the underlying assets, etc. of a held exposure is calculated pursuant to the preceding paragraph, the amount of credit risk-weighted assets of the exposures of those underlying assets, etc. shall be calculated, according to the category of those exposures listed in the following items, as provided in those items: (i) Equity exposures: Article 128 (limited to the part relating to item (i)) applies mutatis mutandis, deeming the third party referred to in the preceding paragraph to be the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach that directly holds those equity exposures. In this case, the phrase "the sum of the following amounts" in that Article shall be deemed to be replaced with "the amount listed in item (i) (in calculating that amount, an adjustment shall be made by multiplying the risk weight applicable to each individual asset and transaction by 1.2)". (ii) Securitization exposures: Article 128 (limited to the part relating to item (iii)) applies mutatis mutandis, deeming the third party referred to in the preceding paragraph to be the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach that directly holds those securitization exposures. In this case, the phrase "amount of credit risk-weighted assets" in that item shall be deemed to be replaced with "amount of credit risk-weighted assets (in calculating that amount, the risk weight shall be calculated by the external ratings-based method prescribed in Division 3 of Subsection 2 of Section 2 of the same Chapter, and an adjustment shall be made by multiplying that risk weight by 1.2)". (iii) Exposures other than those listed in the preceding two items: Article 14 applies mutatis mutandis, deeming the third party referred to in the preceding paragraph to be the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach that directly holds those exposures. In this case, the phrase "the sum of the amounts" in that Article shall be deemed to be replaced with "the sum of the amounts (excluding the amount listed in item (iii)), and in calculating that sum, an adjustment shall be made by multiplying the risk weight applicable to each individual asset and transaction by 1.2"; the phrase "that Section" shall be deemed to be replaced with "that Section, after using as the risk weight the value obtained by multiplying that risk weight by 1.2"; and the phrase "credit equivalent amount" in item (i) of that Article shall be deemed to be replaced with "credit equivalent amount (where those derivative transactions include a derivative transaction whose counterparty is a person other than those listed in the items of Article 248-2, paragraph (2), the credit equivalent amount of off-balance sheet transactions, the amount obtained by multiplying by 1.5 the credit equivalent amount of that derivative transaction, the credit equivalent amount of derivative transactions other than that derivative transaction, and the credit equivalent amount of long settlement period transactions)".

Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach is unable to satisfy the requirements listed in the items of paragraph (2) and the investment mandate has been explicitly stated, it may use, as the amount of credit risk-weighted assets of the held exposure, the amount obtained by multiplying the amount of the held exposure by the ratio obtained by dividing the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets of the underlying assets, etc. of the held exposure, calculated so as to be the maximum under that investment mandate, by the amount of total assets of the entity that actually holds those underlying assets, etc.

In the case of the preceding paragraph, in calculating the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets of the underlying assets, etc. of a held exposure, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall assume a composition of the underlying assets, etc. that maximizes that total amount of credit risk-weighted assets under the investment mandate referred to in that paragraph, and shall calculate the amount of credit risk-weighted assets of the exposures of the underlying assets, etc. in that composition, according to the category of those exposures listed in the following items, as provided in those items: (i) Equity exposures: Article 128 (limited to the part relating to item (i)) applies mutatis mutandis, deeming that Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach to be the person directly holding those equity exposures. In this case, the phrase "the sum of the following amounts" in that Article shall be deemed to be replaced with "the amount listed in item (i)". (ii) Securitization exposures: Article 128 (limited to the part relating to item (iii)) applies mutatis mutandis, deeming that Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach to be the person directly holding those securitization exposures. In this case, the phrase "amount of credit risk-weighted assets" in that item shall be deemed to be replaced with "amount of credit risk-weighted assets (in calculating that amount, the risk weight shall be calculated by the external ratings-based method prescribed in Division 3 of Subsection 2 of Section 2 of the same Chapter)". (iii) Exposures other than those listed in the preceding two items: Article 14 applies mutatis mutandis, deeming that Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach to be the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach that directly holds those exposures. In this case, the phrase "means the sum of the amounts" in that Article shall be deemed to be replaced with "means the sum of the amounts (excluding the amount listed in item (iii))", and the phrase "credit equivalent amount" in item (i) of that Article shall be deemed to be replaced with "credit equivalent amount (where those derivative transactions include a derivative transaction whose counterparty is a person other than those listed in the items of Article 248-2, paragraph (2), the credit equivalent amount of off-balance sheet transactions, the amount obtained by multiplying by 1.5 the credit equivalent amount of that derivative transaction, the credit equivalent amount of derivative transactions other than that derivative transaction, and the credit equivalent amount of long settlement period transactions)".

Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach calculates the amount of credit risk-weighted assets of a held exposure pursuant to paragraph (2) or paragraph (7), it shall calculate that amount after making an adjustment of multiplying the ratio listed in each of the following items by the value specified in that item; provided, however, that where the ratio obtained as a result of that adjustment exceeds 1,250%, that ratio shall be 1,250%: (i) The ratio under paragraph (2): the value obtained by dividing the amount of total assets of the entity by the amount of net assets; (ii) The ratio under paragraph (7): the value specified in the preceding item, being the maximum permitted under the investment mandate.

Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach is unable to satisfy the requirements listed in the items of paragraph (2) and is unable to apply paragraph (7), and has made a prima facie showing that it is highly probable that the risk weight of the held exposure is at the ratio listed in one of the following items, it may calculate the amount of credit risk-weighted assets by using for that held exposure the risk weight specified in that item: (i) 250% or less: a risk weight of 250%; (ii) More than 250% and up to 400%: a risk weight of 400%.

Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach is unable to satisfy the requirements listed in the items of paragraph (2) and is unable to apply paragraph (7) and the preceding paragraph, it shall calculate the amount of credit risk-weighted assets by using a risk weight of 1,250% for the held exposure.
